title_en: Notice of the 10th Seoul National University Development Foundation Sharing Contest
summary: The department has announced the 10th Seoul National University Development Foundation Sharing Contest. The notice text gives no eligibility, deadline or submission location; these details are in the two attached files, which were not read. Students who wish to take part should read the attached implementation plan and use the attached application form.
applies_to: Not stated in the notice text. Eligibility may be set out in the attached implementation plan, which was not read.
conditions: The notice text states no eligibility rules, deadlines or submission requirements; these are presumably in the attached files, which were not read.
steps: Read the attached implementation plan, '제10회 서울대학교발전재단 나눔공모전 시행(안).pdf' (113 KB), for eligibility, deadlines and submission instructions.
Download the attached application and forms file, '제10회 서울대학교발전재단 나눔공모전 지원서 및 양식.hwp' (54 KB), and complete it as the implementation plan instructs.
For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
